ext_messenger_templates_desc_1: Create pre-defined headers and footers for WhatsApp and Telegram.
ext_messenger_templates_desc_2: You can set a template as Default to automatically format outgoing Hecos messages.
ext_messenger_telegram_desc: Sends and receives messages, photos, documents, and voice notes via the official Telegram Bot API. Create bots via @BotFather.
ext_messenger_tg_persona_match: Auto-select Bot matching active Persona / Soul
ext_messenger_tg_persona_match_desc: Automatically sends from the bot matching the active AI persona (e.g. speaking with Urania uses the Urania bot; speaking with Hecos uses the hecos bot), falling back to Primary Bot otherwise.
ext_messenger_tg_groups_desc: Register your Telegram groups and channels here (with optional voice/STT aliases like 'ecos' for 'Hecos') so AI personas send directly to the right group without polluting personal Contacts.
ext_messenger_tg_override_desc: Included automatically in dynamic routing rules whenever Telegram is enabled. Customize how the AI handles Telegram bots and media.
ext_messenger_whatsapp_intro: Hecos automatically resolves contacts from your Address Book (Contacts) and sends messages and attachments via WhatsApp Web. Choose which delivery method Hecos should use:
ext_messenger_wa_mode_cdp_desc: Connects to your already-open Chrome/Edge via remote debugging port (default 9222). You see the chat open and send live inside your browser. Zero extra RAM, but requires your browser to run with CDP enabled.
ext_messenger_wa_mode_dedicated_desc: Manages a separate Chromium instance with its own persistent profile (hecos/data/whatsapp_session). Works even when your personal browser is closed and never touches your tabs. Scan the QR code once via 'Open / Link WhatsApp Web'.
ext_messenger_wa_auto_open_tab: Auto-open WhatsApp Web tab if closed
ext_messenger_wa_auto_open_tab_desc: Automatically opens https://web.whatsapp.com if no WhatsApp Web tab is currently open.
ext_messenger_wa_headless_desc: Enable ONLY after you have already scanned the QR code once. When off, you will see the dedicated window on screen.
ext_messenger_wa_banner_dedicated_headle: Messages are sent via an isolated Chromium profile (hecos/data/whatsapp_session) running invisibly in the background (headless), even when your personal browser is closed.
ext_messenger_wa_banner_dedicated_visibl: Messages are sent via a dedicated isolated Chromium window (hecos/data/whatsapp_session), independent from your personal browser.
ext_messenger_wa_banner_cdp_autotab: Messages are sent by attaching to your open browser on CDP port __PORT__ (if WhatsApp Web is not open, Hecos opens the tab automatically).
ext_messenger_wa_banner_cdp_manual: Messages are sent only when a WhatsApp Web tab is already open in your browser on CDP port __PORT__.
ext_messenger_whatsapp_use_template_desc: Wraps outgoing WhatsApp messages with the selected template.
ext_messenger_wa_sig_enable_desc: Prepends a bold *[Name]* tag at the top of group messages (turn OFF if your Template already includes a signature).
ext_messenger_wa_sig_mode_auto: Automatic (Active Soul / Persona, e.g. Urania, Hecos)
ext_messenger_whatsapp_country_code_desc: Automatically added to numbers saved in Contacts without a country prefix (e.g. +39 for Italy).
ext_messenger_whatsapp_single_block: Send multi-line text as a single message (Recommended)
ext_messenger_whatsapp_single_block_desc: Keeps multi-line texts, poems, and templates inside one single WhatsApp bubble instead of multiple messages.
ext_messenger_whatsapp_cdp_timeout_desc: Max wait time for browser connection and chat loading.
ext_messenger_whatsapp_worker_timeout_de: Max total execution time for sending a message or attachment.
ext_messenger_wa_groups_desc: Register WhatsApp groups here so AI personas can send messages, photos, and documents by group name, optionally sign messages as *[Persona]*, and listen/reply in authorized groups.
ext_messenger_wa_discovered_label: Groups Found on WhatsApp Web (Click to Add):
ext_messenger_wa_override_desc: Included automatically in dynamic routing rules whenever WhatsApp is enabled. Customize how the AI handles WhatsApp requests.
ext_messenger_routing_title: General AI Routing, Follow-up Memory & Safety Guard
ext_messenger_routing_desc: Transparent, user-editable rules controlling follow-up channel continuity, clarification questions when a recipient/platform is ambiguous, and anti-hallucination protection.
ext_messenger_followup_desc: Remembers the last verified recipient and platform so immediate follow-up prompts stay on the same channel (e.g. WhatsApp instead of switching to Telegram). When expired or unsure, Hecos asks 'To whom and on which platform?' instead of guessing.
ext_messenger_general_override_desc: Global Messenger rules combined with active WhatsApp/Telegram overrides and synced live to hecos/hpm/messenger/routing_override.yaml.
ext_messenger_guard_desc: Intercepts plain-text responses where the AI claims a message was sent without invoking MESSENGER, forcing either a real tool execution or an honest clarification question.
